player.intro: Ready for your next learning adventure?
player.demoNote: Current games are demos; demo results do not award points or history.
player.historyNote: Verified game results will appear here.

flagQuest.title: Flag Quest
flagQuest.missionsNote: Choose a mission. Switching restarts the current mission progress.

toast.allGates: All gates open! Head to the flagpole.

notice.locked: Open every gate before raising the flag.
notice.generic: That action is not available right now.

objective.label: Objective
objective.flag: Go to the flagpole and raise the flag!
objective.done: Mission complete! The flag is flying.

state.offline: The game server cannot be reached.
state.unavailable: The game server is not configured yet. Contact an admin.
state.gradeRequired: Set your school grade on the dashboard so questions match your level.

quick_quiz.title: Quick Quiz
quick_quiz.rule: Answer at least {{needed}} multiple-choice questions correctly.

true_false.title: True or False
true_false.rule: Decide true or false, at least {{needed}} correct.

math_sprint.title: Math Sprint
math_sprint.rule: Solve {{needed}} sums before time runs out.

snakes_ladders.title: Mini Snakes & Ladders
snakes_ladders.rule: Roll the dice, then answer correctly to move. A 6 earns another roll. Reach square 25 before your turns run out!

challenge.boardLabel: Snakes and ladders board, pawn on square {{position}}
challenge.passedNote: The gate is open. Keep going!
challenge.failedNote: Take a short break and try again.
challenge.answerToMove: You rolled {{roll}}. Answer correctly to move {{roll}} squares!
challenge.slid: Slid down a snake from {{from}} to {{to}}.

complete.title: Flag raised!
complete.saved: Points are saved to your account automatically.

lakeside.name: Lakeside Camp
lakeside.description: Your first adventure by the lake. Three challenge stations await.

forest.name: Pine Forest
forest.description: A longer forest trail with tougher challenges.

summit.name: Hill Summit
summit.description: The hardest mission: math sprints and rapid quizzes.

portal.title: Game Portal
portal.pointsNote: Points you earned from games labelled "Earns points".
portal.pointsRule: Only games labelled "Earns points" are verified by the server and add points. Practice games do not add points.
portal.leaderboardEmpty: No players with points yet. Be the first!

games.title: Educational games
games.flagQuest: Explore the map, beat quizzes, snakes & ladders and math sprints at each station, then raise the flag.
games.snakes: 100-square snakes & ladders for 2–4 players taking turns, with questions from many subjects.
games.sky: Fly the jet, collect correct answers, and shoot wrong ones. Questions follow your grade and results earn points.

sky.title: Sukhoi Sky Quiz
sky.intro: Press Start flying to get the first question.
sky.hint: Fly into the CORRECT answer. Shoot WRONG answers and drones.
sky.noCanvas: Use a browser that supports Canvas to play.
sky.canvasLabel: Sukhoi arena. Arrows or WASD to fly, space to shoot, P to pause. On touch screens, drag the jet and hold the fire button.

overlay.needGrade: Set your grade on the home page first so questions match your level.
overlay.onlineRules: {{rounds}} questions for grade {{grade}}. Collect the correct answer, shoot wrong answers and drones. Results are verified by the server and earn points.
overlay.guestRules: Demo mode: pick grade 1–4. Log in so questions follow your grade and results earn points.
overlay.unavailable: The game server is not available yet. Please try again later.

result.demo: Demo mode does not award points.
result.shieldsExplained: Shields are the jet's lives ({{max}} in total). You lose one each time you touch a wrong answer, shoot the correct answer, let the answers pass, or crash into a meteor. With no shields left the flight stopped at question {{done}} of {{total}}.
result.passHint: Answer more than {{percent}}% correctly to earn the congratulations.
result.noPoints: No extra points this time — your account points stay the same.

feedback.shot_correct: That was the correct answer: {{answer}}. Don't shoot it!

errors.generic: The server rejected that action. Keep flying.

footer.online: Arrows/WASD or drag to fly. Space or hold Fire. P to pause. Questions follow your profile grade; points are counted by the server.
footer.guest: Arrows/WASD or drag to fly. Space or hold Fire. Demo mode does not award points.

sky.finished: Flight finished. See your results below.
sky.finishedPassed: Great job! You answered more than 70% correctly.
